name: Kidcore
summary: Primary colours, rainbows, stickers, toys, cartoon animals and 1990s kid-show graphics, stacked in dense collage. It uses the childhood of the 1980s and 1990s as a happy, loud look.

philosophy.core_thesis: Treat the childhood bedroom of the 1990s as a design system: bright, crowded and joyful on purpose.
design_principles: Use saturated primaries: red (#E8352E), blue (#2D5BFF), yellow (#FFD21F) and green (#2DBE60), on a white or pale yellow ground.
Fill 60% to 80% of the frame: stickers, stars, smileys, toys and rainbow arcs overlap by 8px to 24px.
Set headings in a chunky, round display face at 48px to 96px, with a 3px black outline or a hard 4px shadow.
Cut stickers with a 6px white border and a 3px hard shadow in #1B1B1B.
Use confetti, polka dots and checkers as patterns at 24px to 48px tiles.
Add a second layer of nostalgia: bubble type, a CRT frame or a cartoon cursor at 32px.
Rotate loose elements by -6° to +6° so nothing sits square.
anti_patterns: Minimal layouts with large empty areas

layout.grid_mechanics: A loose collage on a 12-column base with 16px gutters; stickers and panels overlap and sit at free angles.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 5% to 15% of the surface stays empty; the spacing scale is 4, 8, 16 and 32px.
layout.alignment_rules: Mixed alignment; headings sit centred or on a -4° slope; stickers sit at the corners.
layout.container_geometry: Rounded boxes with a 16px radius, a 3px black outline and a 4px hard offset shadow; stars, circles and clouds as accents.

font_pairings.note: A soft, round display face with a friendly text sans.
A fat, round face that echoes children's book covers.
A bouncy hand-drawn display face for stickers.

hierarchy_rules: Set headings in mixed colours, one colour for each letter.
Set body text in dark ink on white, never on a saturated colour.

color.palette_structure: Four primaries plus pink and white, on a white or pale yellow ground, with black outlines.
color.contrast_rules: Marker black on white holds 17:1; the primaries carry fills and outlines, and white text sits only on blue or red at 24px or more.
color.surface_treatment: Flat saturated fills, glossy sticker shine as a white diagonal at 40% opacity, and confetti patterns.
color.light_and_shadow: A hard, offset shadow of 4px in black; no soft shadow.

materiality.surface_simulation: Vinyl stickers, plastic toys, crayon and early cartoon cels.
materiality.border_rules: A 3px black outline on every container; a 6px white border on stickers.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: A hard 4px shadow in black; no blur.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Solid icons at 28px with 3px outlines and round caps, inside a circle tile in a primary colour.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Rainbows, stars, smileys, dinosaurs, teddy bears, cartoon fruit and pixel hearts, cut out as stickers.

motion.transition_physics: Bouncy: elements pop in with a 110% overshoot over 300ms; stickers wiggle by 4° at 1s loops.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover wiggles the sticker by 6° and scales it to 108%; active state squashes it to 94%.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels playful, nostalgic and free to be silly.

avoid_when: The audience expects a serious or luxury tone.
The page carries long, dense reading.
The brand needs calm, trust and restraint.

modifiers.how: Swap primaries for pastel sage, rose and butter; keep the stickers, reduce the outlines to 1px.
Replace the primaries with one hot pink (#E0218A) and white; keep the outlines.
Add chrome type, translucent plastic and a silver and baby blue palette.

pack.why: A fat, rounded fill family that matches sticker shapes.

ground.why: Kidcore stands on scattered confetti, like the floor of a party or a toy box.
